items.stem: Under the HIPAA Privacy Rule, which principle requires limiting PHI shared to only what is needed for the task?

options.rationale: Correct: the minimum-necessary standard limits use and disclosure of PHI to what is needed for the purpose.
Breach notification governs informing affected parties after an impermissible disclosure, not the amount shared routinely.
Right of access concerns a patient obtaining their own records, not limiting what staff share.
The treatment context has broader permitted sharing; it is not the principle that limits the amount disclosed.

items.explanation: Correct: the minimum-necessary standard limits use and disclosure of PHI to what is needed for the purpose.

items.stem: The HIPAA Security Rule groups safeguards into categories. Which TWO of the following are Security Rule safeguard categories? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: administrative safeguards (policies, training, risk management) are one of the three categories.
Correct: technical safeguards (access controls, audit, encryption) are a defined category.
There is no 'financial safeguards' category in the Security Rule.
Marketing is addressed under the Privacy Rule's use-and-disclosure provisions, not as a Security Rule safeguard category.

items.explanation: Correct: administrative safeguards (policies, training, risk management) are one of the three categories.

items.stem: A clinic hires an outside billing company that will handle patient records on its behalf. What does HIPAA most directly require before sharing PHI with them?

options.rationale: Correct: a vendor handling PHI on a covered entity's behalf is a business associate, requiring a written business associate agreement.

options.text: Individual patient authorisation for each record
options.rationale: Routine payment and operations disclosures generally do not require per-record patient authorisation.

options.text: Nothing, because billing is exempt from HIPAA
options.rationale: Billing operations are not exempt; PHI handled by a vendor is covered.

options.text: Public posting of the clinic's privacy notice only
options.rationale: A notice of privacy practices does not by itself authorise a vendor to process PHI.

items.explanation: Correct: a vendor handling PHI on a covered entity's behalf is a business associate, requiring a written business associate agreement.
